name: onboarding-api
description: Owns new hire records, the standard onboarding task template, and the onboarding tasks generated for each new hire across IT, HR and Facilities. Generates a hire's checklist from the template on creation, and tracks due dates and completion. Flags a task overdue once its due date passes without completion, surfaced in-app to the assigned staff member and to HR — it sends no external notification. Does not manage payroll/benefits, or track physical asset inventory.
